title: TesseraQL app configuration (config/tesseraql.yml)
$comment: Deliberately open (additionalProperties: true) at every level: newer keys never break older editors. Descriptions and the keys below mirror the scaffolded config and its consumers (ScaffoldedConfigKeys).

name.description: The application name: tags job executions, outbox events, and per-app operations scope (ops.app.<name>).

work.description: The work directory for runtime artifacts (default: <home>/work).

datasources.description: Named datasources; main is the default. Documented in multi-datasource.md.

password.description: Prefer a ${secret.*} reference over a literal.

routes.description: Path-matched security defaults, first match wins (* = one segment, ** = many). Documented in route-defaults.md.

match.description: The URL path pattern this rule covers.

csrf.description: auto requires CSRF exactly when auth is browser and the method is not GET.

responseHeaders.description: Response headers stamped on every route response (CSP, X-Frame-Options, ...). A flat map of header name to value.

policies.description: Named authorization policies: each grants when any listed role or permission matches.

secret.description: Prefer a ${secret.*} reference over a literal.

defaultLocale.description: BCP-47 tag the message catalogs fall back to (default en).

poll.description: Poll-source connectivity, deny-by-default. Documented in connectors.md.

allowedPaths.description: Roots a local poll source may watch; a local poll without one is refused.

knownHostsFile.description: SSH known-hosts file for strict SFTP host-key checking.

trustStore.description: FTPS server-certificate trust; without it an ftps source is refused (TQL-SEC-4085).

credentials.description: Named poll credentials (username plus exactly one of password/privateKeyFile; optional FTPS keyStore* for mutual TLS).

idleTimeout.description: Invalidate a session unseen for this long (duration string) - sliding, inside the absolute ttl. Unset disables it (docs/session-visibility.md).

maxPerSubject.description: Cap live sessions per account: a login beyond it evicts the subject's oldest session (newest login wins). 1 = single-session policy. Unset = unlimited.

store.description: memory (default, per-node) or jdbc (shared, survives restarts).

enabled.description: Serve the Prometheus exposition endpoint (default false).

unauthenticated.description: Let a cluster-internal scraper skip the bearer gate (default false).

enabled.description: Record every route invocation to the route audit trail (default false).

fixedDelay.description: How often the dispatcher claims pending events (duration string).

maxAttempts.description: Delivery attempts before an event dead-letters.

sweep.description: How often the retention sweeper runs (duration string).

outbox.description: How long delivered outbox events are kept.

jobs.description: How long finished job executions are kept.
